page.title: Read a snapshot without restoring it
page.description: tinyactors inspect and tinyactors actors read the snapshots and hibernation blobs a host writes: every actor's chart, state, queued events and delayed sends.

hero.headline: Read a snapshot without restoring it
hero.lede: A snapshot holds every actor of a host, and a hibernation blob holds one. tinyactors actors lists where each actor is, from the file alone.

section.heading: Snapshot a host of orders
section.p: This session spawns 20 orders and pays and ships some. Then it adds the chart's next version, hibernates order 17 and snapshots the host.
section.code: tinyactors run --config shop.json --system shop system.xml < shop.jsonl
section.p: The site's build runs it with the release, and the command pages below read the file it writes, shop.snapshot.

section.heading: Ask the file where each order is

item.text: Every actor: its chart, version, state, the events in its mailbox and its delayed sends, such as a payment timeout.
What the snapshot holds: its segments, images and time, and for a blob, the session it is and whether it wakes in that snapshot.
The states of the chart a segment runs, with --segment for a version other than the newest.

section.heading: The command reads its own release's formats

claim.statement: A snapshot is one build's memory
claim.p: Snapshots and blobs are raw memory of one build of the library, each format with a version. The command reads its own library's formats, and names any other.
